.container{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--spacing-md);padding-top:var(--spacing-md);padding-bottom:var(--spacing-md);}.logo{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-variant:small-caps;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0.25em;color:var(--color-primary);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--spacing-md);margin:0;padding:0;}nav a{color:var(--color-text);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;padding:0.3rem 0.1rem;}nav a:hover,nav a:focus{text-decoration:underline;color:var(--color-primary);}footer{background:var(--color-dark-bg);color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);padding:var(--spacing-lg) 0;text-align:center;}footer a{color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);}footer .footer-logo{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-variant:small-caps;letter-spacing:0.2em;font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:var(--spacing-sm);}.button,button,input[type="submit"]{display:inline-block;background:var(--color-primary);color:#ffffff;border:none;padding:0.75rem 1.75rem;min-height:44px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--font-body);text-align:center;}.button:hover,button:hover,input[type="submit"]:hover{background:var(--color-primary-dark);}.button-secondary{background:transparent;color:var(--color-primary);border:2px solid var(--color-primary);}.button-secondary:hover{background:var(--color-primary);color:#fff;}.grid{display:grid;gap:1.5rem;grid-template-columns:1fr;}.card{background:var(--color-surface);padding:1.5rem;border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);}section{padding:var(--spacing-lg) 0;}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;}th,td{text-align:left;padding:0.75rem 0.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid #eadfd9;}th{font-family:var(--font-heading);color:var(--color-primary-dark);}form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--spacing-md);max-width:30rem;}label{font-weight:600;margin-bottom:0.25rem;display:block;}input,textarea,select{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:0.5rem 0.75rem;border:1px solid #cbb7ae;border-radius:var(--radius);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:1rem;background:#fff;color:var(--color-text);}textarea{min-height:8rem;}blockquote{font-style:italic;color:var(--color-text-light);border-left:4px .container{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}section{padding:var(--spacing-md) 0;}.logo{font-size:1.2rem;}}@media pages.title: Lavish Locks Salon — Hair Styling, Prices & Online Booking
pages.html:
✂ Lavish Locks
  • Services
  • Prices
  • Testimonials
  • Booking
  • Contact

Lavish Locks Salon — Hair Styling, Prices & Online Booking

Step into a space where craft meets comfort. Our stylists blend classic technique with modern trends to give you a look that feels like you — only better. Browse our services, see our prices, and reserve your chair in minutes.

Book Your Appointment

Our Services

From everyday trims to transformative color, every service includes a consultation, a relaxing shampoo and a finishing style.

Cut & Style

Precision cuts tailored to your face shape and lifestyle, finished with a blow-dry and styling.

Color & Highlights

Full color, balayage or foil highlights using ammonia-free, nourishing formulas.

Blowouts & Updos

Smooth, voluminous blowouts and elegant updos for everyday polish or special occasions.

Treatments

Deep-conditioning masks, keratin smoothing and scalp treatments to restore shine and health.

Bridal & Events

On-site trial and day-of styling packages for brides, bridal parties and special events.

Men's Grooming

Classic and modern cuts, beard shaping and hot towel finishes.

Service Menu & Prices

Prices reflect stylist time and product quality; a detailed quote is always provided before your service begins.

Hair salon services and prices
ServiceDurationPrice
Women's Haircut & Style45 min$55
Men's Haircut30 min$35
All-Over Color90 min$95+
Balayage / Highlights2.5 hr$150+
Blowout40 min$45
Updo / Special Occasion60 min$75
Keratin Smoothing Treatment2 hr$180
Deep Conditioning Treatment20 min$25
Bridal Trial75 min$90

What Our Clients Say

"Best balayage I've ever had — natural, dimensional, and it grew out beautifully."

— Dana R.

"Booked online in two minutes and the stylist remembered my preferences from last visit. Love this place."

— Marcus T.

"My bridal updo lasted through dancing all night. Couldn't have asked for better care."

— Priya S.

Book Online

Reserve your appointment in just a few clicks. Choose your service, pick a stylist, and select a time that works for you.

Book Your Appointment Now

Prefer to talk first? Call us at (555) 213-7890.

Visit & Opening Hours

Springfield, IL 62701

Phone: (555) 213-7890
Email: hello@lavishlocks.com

Hours

  • Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM
  • Saturday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Sunday: Closed

Send Us an Inquiry
